newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London quiet, HSBC up.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London quiet, HSBC up.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks trading in London were little changed on Monday but a continued strong performance by HSBC Holdings lifted the Hang Seng London Reference Index, dealers said.
"It's been a pretty lacklustre day here after a disappointing day in Hong Kong," one trader said.

Shares in HSBC hit an all-time high in Hong Kong on Monday and dealers said the stock had been the main feature in London. Although HSBC shares on the London stock exchange were lower, its Hong Kong shares continued to climb in London trade, and were around HK$1.5 above their Hong Kong close by 1500 GMT.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index was 25.86 points up at 13,669.40. Dealers said most of this change was attributable to HSBC.
Overnight the Hang Seng ended 16.96 points lower in Hong Kong at 13,643.54 after an early rally evaporated.
